pinterest.title: Mykonos Wedding Venues on the West Coast: Chapels and Sunset Views Near Mykonos Town
pinterest.description: The west-coast bays of Agios Ioannis and Ornos keep your guests close to Mykonos Town. Santa Marina has a traditional whitewashed stone chapel on its private peninsula at the southern tip of Ornos Bay. Mykonos Grand's hilltop chapel looks out over Agios Ioannis beach and frames outdoor ceremonies for up to 100, while Saint John, at what it calls one of the island's sunset spots, hosts weddings of up to 800 guests. Compare 10 Mykonos wedding venues by area.

pinterest.title: Mykonos Wedding Venues in Elia: A Whitewashed Chapel and a Ballroom That Seats 270
pinterest.description: In Elia, the Myconian Collection offers vows in a small whitewashed chapel, then a reception on the beach or in a restaurant overlooking the Aegean and Mykonos Town. The semi-open Horizons Ballroom seats 270 at round tables and takes up to 550 for cocktails. The team assists in officiating ceremonies across all denominations, and the kitchens are certified halal and kosher. A strong fit for a multicultural wedding. Compare 10 Mykonos wedding venues.

pinterest.title: North Coast Mykonos Wedding Venues: A Private Chapel at Agios Sostis
pinterest.description: Grecotel Mykonos Lolita is a little hotel on a secluded private beach after Agios Sostis, off the beaten path, with a path down to the sand. It holds religious, civil and symbolic weddings at its private chapel above the Aegean, and many rooms look over Panormos Bay. Choose the north coast for a small wedding with privacy, and ask how a civil ceremony there works for an Australian couple. Compare 10 Mykonos wedding venues.

slides: 10 Mykonos wedding venues for a Cycladic celebration. Choose the part of the island first: it shapes your ceremony, your view and how guests get around.
Agios Ioannis and Ornos: the west-coast bays near Mykonos Town. Santa Marina has a whitewashed stone chapel on its own peninsula, and Saint John hosts weddings of up to 800.
Psarou and Platis Gialos: beach receptions on the south coast. Mykonos Blu holds ceremonies for up to 60 on its Ocean Balcony, just above Psarou beach.
Elia: the Myconian Collection's home for larger weddings. Vows in a small whitewashed chapel, then the Horizons Ballroom, which seats 270 at round tables.
Agios Sostis and the north coast: Grecotel Mykonos Lolita, a little hotel on a secluded private beach, holds religious, civil and symbolic weddings at its private chapel.
Above Paradise beach: ZeNIT Events Center is a hilltop event venue with views to Delos. It has no rooms, so guests stay elsewhere and gather for the day.
Check the ceremony type first. At Mykonos Grand, a religious wedding on the premises needs both partners to be Christian Orthodox. Ask every venue what it can hold for you.

instagram_carousel.caption:
Which part of Mykonos suits your wedding?

Mykonos wedding venues fall into five parts of the island: the west-coast bays of Agios Ioannis and Ornos near Mykonos Town, the south-coast beaches at Psarou and Platis Gialos, Elia further east, the north coast at Agios Sostis, and a hilltop above Paradise beach.

Our new guide sets out 10 venues across those areas, each on the same terms: setting, ceremony options, largest published capacity, rooms and exclusive use. It is not a ranking.

The short version: if guests want to be near town, start on the west coast. If you want the beach in every photograph, look south. If you want privacy and a chapel, look north. Check the ceremony type before you fall for the view, because the rules differ from chapel to chapel. For a summer date, plan shade, a later start and a covered fallback, as Greek summers bring frequent heatwaves and a wildfire season from June to September.

Shortlisting Mykonos venues for your own wedding? Send us a message with your date, guest count and the venues you have in mind, and a Wedded Advisor will help you compare them. Your advisor works in your time zone, quotes in AUD and confirms every inclusion in writing before you commit. Full guide at the link in our bio.
